rules.boundary_rules: Boundary siting and noise are usually the first planning pressure points for heat pumps across East Sussex, especially where the unit sits near neighbours or a quiet garden edge.
rules.roof_rules: Heat pumps across East Sussex are usually easier where the main roof form stays visually quiet. Roof-mounted units, brackets and prominent pipework can make a domestic retrofit feel more like plant equipment and often need a closer planning check.
